entries.english: My neighbors on both sides of me love helping people.
entries.fr: Mes voisins des deux côtés adorent rendre service.

entries.english: You have pressed the pound sign.
entries.fr: Vous avez pressé dièse.

entries.english: Thank you for paying for the repairs.
entries.fr: Merci d'avoir payé les réparations.

entries.english: Word is, there are monsters up on the mountain.
entries.fr: Il y aurait des monstres sur la montagne.

entries.english: Nobody's here...
entries.fr: Personne ici...

entries.english: I can give you up to three hints.
entries.fr: Je peux donner trois indices.

entries.english: Why do you keep insisting on talking to me?
entries.fr: Pourquoi tiens-tu tant à me parler?

entries.english: Suspicious man...
entries.fr: Un type louche...

entries.english: Queen Mary often has nightmares.
entries.fr: Mary a souvent des cauchemars.

entries.english: I am a swimming cat.
entries.fr: Je suis chat nageur.

entries.english: Oh, okay. Thanks!
entries.fr: Ah, OK. Merci!

entries.english: So, you've realized what good taste I have...
entries.fr: Tu as enfin reconnu mon bon goût...

entries.english: Happiness won't just walk into your life on its own.
entries.fr: Le bonheur ne viendra pas tout seul à toi.

entries.english: Had a good sleep?
entries.fr: Bien dormi?

entries.english: The Ocarina of Hope is finally complete.
entries.fr: L'Ocarina de l'espoir est enfin terminé.

entries.english: I'm a cat that swims in the ground.
entries.fr: Je nage sous terre, moi, le chat.

entries.english: What do you want me to store?
entries.fr: Que veux-tu que je garde?

entries.english: Hey, you two there.
entries.fr: Hé, vous deux, là.

entries.english: I'm a tough guy.
entries.fr: Je suis un dur.

entries.english: In a fight between you and me...
entries.fr: Si on se battait, toi et moi...

entries.english: I have a fantastic source for weapons.
entries.fr: J'ai un excellent fournisseur d'armes.

entries.english: It's a secret...
entries.fr: C'est secret...

entries.english: Wow, you're so cute.
entries.fr: Oh, tu es mignon!

entries.english: Hey, you can't drink that!
entries.fr: Hé, ne bois pas ça!

entries.english: Brute strength is not enough to beat 'em.
entries.fr: La force seule ne suffit pas.

entries.english: The train tracks aren't blocked anymore.
entries.fr: Les voies ferrées ne sont plus bloquées.

entries.english: I'm so relieved!
entries.fr: Ouf, enfin!

entries.english: Thank you for your cooperation.
entries.fr: Merci de votre coopération.

entries.english: I wanted to tell you this as soon as I saw you...
entries.fr: Je voulais te le dire dès que je t'ai vu...

entries.english: Someone's in here!
entries.fr: Quelqu'un est là!

entries.english: Of course the door to the roof is locked!
entries.fr: Bien sûr que la porte du toit est fermée!

entries.english: You want to be my friend?
entries.fr: Tu veux être mon ami?

entries.english: I'm a weird teacher who secretly lives in the school.
entries.fr: Je suis un drôle de prof qui vit dans l'école.

entries.english: There was a rockslide near Union Station.
entries.fr: Un éboulement a bloqué Union Station.

entries.english: Hello and thank you for calling the Hint Union!
entries.fr: Bonjour, ici le Syndicat des indices!

entries.english: In the heart of Downtown Ellay, there's a music venue called the Live House.
entries.fr: Au coeur d'Ellay, il y a une salle appelée Live House.

entries.english: It seems like you've seen all that the city of Ellay has to offer.
entries.fr: On dirait que tu as vu tout ce qu'Ellay peut offrir.

entries.english: I'd love to give you a hint, but I can't think of even one.
entries.fr: J'aimerais t'aider, mais je n'ai pas un seul indice.

entries.english: Did a poltergeist visit your house?
entries.fr: Un esprit hante ta maison?

entries.english: So nice to have my dentures back once more.
entries.fr: Quel bonheur de retrouver mon dentier!

entries.english: There was a rockslide near Union Station.
entries.fr: Un éboulement a bloqué Union Station.

entries.english: The odd sound that drove the animals insane died down.
entries.fr: Le bruit étrange qui rendait les animaux fous a cessé.

entries.english: I'm sure you two would like to be alone.
entries.fr: Vous voulez sûrement rester seuls.

entries.english: EVE was destroyed and ceased functioning.
entries.fr: EVE a été détruite et ne fonctionne plus.

entries.english: EVE was destroyed and ceased functioning.
entries.fr: EVE a été détruite et ne fonctionne plus.

entries.english: There was a rockslide near Union Station.
entries.fr: Un éboulement a bloqué Union Station.

entries.english: I know success will be yours in the end.
entries.fr: Je sais que tu finiras par réussir.

entries.english: I must go on a trip to find my Mom, and...
entries.fr: Je dois partir chercher ma maman, et...

entries.english: The cactus sang...
entries.fr: Le cactus chanta.

entries.english: With the tracks ruined, the train has stopped running.
entries.fr: Les voies sont abîmées, le train ne roule plus.

entries.english: Oh! I'm so happy! Take these swear words with you.
entries.fr: Oh, quelle joie! Emporte ces gros mots avec toi.

entries.english: Welcome to the Automatic Teller Machine.
entries.fr: Bienvenue au distributeur automatique.

entries.english: Please enter the amount of your withdrawal.
entries.fr: Saisis le montant du retrait.

entries.english: Well, how much do you want to withdraw?
entries.fr: Alors, combien veux-tu retirer?

entries.english: You will... never leave!
entries.fr: Tu ne partiras jamais!

entries.english: The Dragon slumbers.
entries.fr: Le Dragon sommeille.

entries.english: The Dragon crooned his tune without much hesitation.
entries.fr: Le Dragon a chanté sans la moindre hésitation.

entries.english: Upon closer look, the gate's lock was already broken.
entries.fr: En regardant bien, le verrou était déjà cassé.

entries.english: Please sing the melodies that you have learned to me.
entries.fr: Chante-moi les mélodies que tu as apprises.

entries.english: Please visit us again!
entries.fr: Revenez nous voir!

entries.english: Do you think the train tickets are too expensive?
entries.fr: Tu trouves les billets de train trop chers?

entries.english: I am Flying Man.
entries.fr: Moi, Flying Man.

entries.english: Have you used the Bullhorn?
entries.fr: Tu as utilisé le mégaphone?
